hooks.description: Display a macOS notification with the Claude Code message
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); MSG=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.message // "Claude Code needs your attention"'); osascript -e "display notification \"$MSG\" with title \"Claude Code\""

hooks.description: Format the edited file with Prettier using the project config
Lint the changed file with markdownlint if it is a Markdown file inside docs/
hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
path = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
if '/docs/' in path and path.endswith('.md'):
    import subprocess
    result = subprocess.run(['npx', 'markdownlint-cli2', path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(result.stdout + result.stderr)
        print('LINT FAILED — fix errors above before proceeding')
        sys.exit(1)
"
